how to open html file with terminal and firefox in linux ubuntu?

To open an HTML file in Firefox from the terminal on Ubuntu, use the following command:

```bash
firefox /path/to/your/file.html
```

Replace
`/path/to/your/file.html` with the actual path to your HTML file. For example, if your file is `index.html` in your

current directory, you would use:

```bash
firefox index.html
```
